about_the_game:
Overview

Haetae: Guardians is a fantasy action-adventure game set in a reimagined version of Joseon, a historical Korean kingdom from the Middle Ages.

In a world where malevolent spirits have overrun the land, a young prince and Haetae—a mythical creature symbolizing protection and justice in East Asian folklore—must stand together to battle corrupted guardian deities and uncover the source of the chaos.

Haetae, portrayed as a mystical and adorable beast, represents purification and water, and holds the power to cleanse guardian spirits who have fallen into darkness.

Key Features

  • Ultimate Skill System
    Earn gauge points by attacking enemies, then unleash devastating ultimate skills!
    Unlock a variety of abilities including speed buffs, area-of-effect skills, and invincibility modes.

  • Haetae’s Power
    Haetae is a guardian beast symbolizing purification in East Asian mythology. When Haetae attacks monsters corrupted by disaster, it lowers their resistance and puts them in a groggy state.

After purifying bosses, Haetae can absorb and transform their powerful skills.
Choose which skills to learn to shape your own unique combat style.

Intense Boss Battles

Face off against legendary East Asian monsters like the Four Guardian Gods, the Gumiho, Maek, and mountain spirits.

Train the Crown Prince and teach Haetae powerful techniques to fight back against those transformed by disaster.

Each boss features unique tactics and patterns, and unlocks new abilities as difficulty increases.
Prepare for fierce battles against mutated mythological foes.

Joseon-Era Setting

Monsters have emerged, plunging Joseon into chaos.
As the Crown Prince destined to be king, embark on a journey to restore your kingdom with the help of Haetae, the guardian of purity.

NPCs & Side Quests

Allies: You can’t stop the calamity alone. Help those around you and learn their techniques—like dash attacks, skill enhancements, and perfect dodges—to build your own playstyle.

Side quests also reward you with Essence, which strengthens Haetae.

Collectibles & Resources

Explore every corner of the map to find special resources and learn new abilities from allies.

Collect unique pets and relics to enhance your adventure.

Endless Challenge

The game doesn’t end after the credits roll.

Climb the Tower of Trials and defeat bosses under extreme conditions. Compete for records and become the ultimate player!
Face wave after wave of increasingly diverse and powerful enemies to push your limits.

short_description: Become the prince chosen by the Yellow Dragon and save Joseon with Haetae. Experience intense battles with simple controls. Use the East Asian divine beast Haetae to unleash skills and ultimate abilities. Strategize synergies through loot and develop your character your way.
